scenes.headline: BUILD YOUR OWN AI OFFICE
scenes.depicts: Build your own AI powered office. Meet Univer, an SDK for adding spreadsheets and documents right inside your app.

scenes.headline: SHEETS + DOCS, BUILT IN
scenes.depicts: Start with editable sheets, formulas, sorting, and rich text documents.

scenes.headline: PLUG IN. CONNECT. BUILD.
scenes.depicts: Plug in only the components you need, then connect your own AI agent through the same API your app uses.

scenes.headline: PEOPLE + AGENTS
scenes.depicts: Your agent can work with spreadsheet content while people edit it in your interface.

scenes.headline: KNOW THE BOUNDARIES
scenes.depicts: The open source core covers sheets and docs. Advanced collaboration and some AI extensions are separately licensed. You bring the model and orchestration.

scenes.headline: YOUR CALL
scenes.depicts: Want the repo? Comment UNIVER and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
